Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The assay uses a specialized isobaric labeling strategy (iqPIR) specifically for cross-linking (XL-MS). While it behaves like an isobaric tag (similar to TMT/iTRAQ), it is integrated into the cross-linker itself. The acquisition is DDA based on the description of precursor selection and fragmentation into reporter ions. The 'mod_complexome' hint is used as the primary goal is the interactome/structural analysis via XL-MS.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The experiment uses in vivo chemical cross-linking within MCF-7 cells followed by digestion of the cell pellets. While the study focuses on protein interactions (interactome), the material analyzed by MS is the resulting peptide mixture from the whole cell pellets, fitting the 'whole cell lysate' scope as no specific sub-fractionation or affinity purification of a specific complex was performed prior to digestion.
